name: wgmma_handoff

devices.h100: sm_90a, pod (wgmma is sm_90a only; no b300 cell)

purpose: The leaf's four fields are predecessor placeholders: group_depth 0-1 cycles 0 / enabled 0 (hopper.placeholder.65d0df53fc929744660515b2) and group_depth >= 2 a discrete table with three QGMMA F32.E4M3.E4M3 ss 64xNx32 points (N 136 / 152 / 192: 111.8 / 139.1 / 74.7, hopper-prototype native-profile handoff_contention_cycles, measurement_verified false) and placeholder_default 0 for every other producer. 445 of 500 h100 single-cluster cases issue wgmma; the first FFMA reading each wgmma's accumulator is gated by this leaf.
engine_semantics: cpp/arch/hopper/wgmma.cpp HopperModule::handoff_ready: an FFMA whose source registers overlap the warp's last wgmma accumulator window may issue at max(now, wgmma complete + fp8 extra + cycles), once per wgmma; group_depth = the warp's wgmma groups still pending at that issue; producer facts (operation_class, datatype, source_mode, tensor_m / n / k) select the cell. The wait itself (WARPGROUP.DEPBAR) is modelled separately by the async-group wait, so the leaf is the delay that remains after the group is complete.
probe: new tools/microbench/wgmma_handoff/probe/handoff.cu, built on tensor_pipe/probe/wgmma_impl.cuh descriptors (no-swizzle K-major smem operands, one CTA of one warpgroup, timing thread warp 0 lane 0). Per rep: wgmma.fence; wgmma A into accumulator set a; commit_group; then D more groups (each one wgmma into accumulator set b, same producer form, commit_group); wgmma.wait_group D (A is complete, D groups pending); t_w = clock64; x = fma.rn.f32(<consumer register>, c, c); y = add.f32(x, 1.0) (waits for x); t_e = clock64; wgmma.wait_group 0; x, y and both accumulator sets folded into a sink. Consumer register: acc cell = a[0] (first accumulator register of A), control cell = a register that is not an accumulator of any wgmma (a pinned seed). D in {0, 1, 2, 3} (group_depth 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 at the consumer). Producer forms (all m64, ss unless stated): HGMMA.64x64x16.F32.BF16, HGMMA.64x128x16.F32.BF16, HGMMA.64x128x16.F32.BF16 rs, HGMMA.64x192x16.F32.F16, HGMMA.64x128x8.F32.TF32, QGMMA.64x128x32.F32.E4M3.E4M3, QGMMA.64x136x32.F32.E4M3.E4M3, QGMMA.64x192x32.F32.E4M3.E4M3 (accumulator sets a and b both fit in 255 registers for N <= 192). --launches 8 --reps 33 (launch 0 and rep 0 dropped), two runs.
sass_gate: per kernel: before t_w exactly 1 + D wgmma of the expected SASS form (HGMMA / QGMMA with the cell's shape and source mode) and the WARPGROUP.DEPBAR.LE of depth D, which precedes the t_w clock read; between the t_w and t_e clock reads exactly one FFMA (reading the acc register in acc cells, the seed register in control cells) and one FADD reading the FFMA result, nothing else; 0 kernels found = gate failure.
derivation: E(form, D, cell) = median over launches of the per-launch median of t_e - t_w. handoff(form, D) = E(form, D, acc) - E(form, D, control): the extra delay of reading a just-completed accumulator over reading an ordinary register, beyond the FFMA / FADD latencies both cells share.
acceptance: a (form, D) value is accepted when both runs give it within 5 % or 2 cycles of each other; |handoff| <= 2 cycles (both runs) counts as 0. Install rule per group_depth bucket of the leaf (0-1 and >= 2): if the accepted values of every measured form in the bucket agree within 3 cycles or 10 % of their median, the bucket gets one constant (median over forms, D 0 and 1 for the 0-1 bucket, D 2 and 3 for >= 2) - the discrete table is replaced by a constant (a field-model change written as its own commit); if they do not agree, the bucket keeps a discrete table with the measured forms as points and placeholder_default stays, and the spread is recorded. If D 0 and D 1 (or D 2 and D 3) disagree beyond the same bound, the group_depth guards are split at that depth first (pure-refactor commit, values copied) and each depth gets its own value. Status: measured when every value in the field passed the run agreement; experimental otherwise. enabled = 1 iff the installed cycles are nonzero anywhere in the bucket; else enabled 0 with the measured source.
install: source wgmma_handoff.h100.<run> (artifact $A/microbench/wgmma_handoff/h100-<run>/, model $A/microbench/wgmma_handoff-model/h100-<run>/model.json); the three predecessor QGMMA points are replaced (their values and the predecessor record are quoted in the source description). hopper.wgmma.fp8_fmnmx_handoff.consumer (QGMMA x FMNMX, another line's binding) is not touched. A/B 500 x 2 single-cluster against the current main baseline.
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold or derivation change after data
